headline: 27-Year-Old Hailed as Hero for Stopping Runaway School Bus
meta_description: A 27-year-old man prevented tragedy by stopping a runaway school bus, protecting children and the driver inside.
summary_short: A quick-thinking 27-year-old stepped in to stop a runaway school bus, saving the young passengers and driver from potential disaster.
body:
A 27-year-old man is being credited with preventing a potential tragedy after he stopped a runaway school bus carrying children and a driver.

The incident unfolded when the bus lost control, creating a dangerous situation for everyone on board. Without hesitation, the man intervened to bring the vehicle to a stop, likely preventing serious harm to the vulnerable passengers inside.

His decisive action serves as a reminder of how everyday courage and quick thinking can change lives. The children and driver owe their safety to a stranger willing to act when it mattered most.
quick_facts: 27-year-old man stopped a runaway school bus
Action protected multiple children on the bus
Driver safety ensured by his intervention
